# E0331: constant with a written `Eq` in a pattern

A pattern compares values field by field, which could disagree with the `eq` you wrote. Compare the constant with `==` in an `if` or a guard.

- Rule: [`patterns.constants-with-written-eq`](../../reference/09-patterns.md#patterns.constants-with-written-eq)
- Reported at: the pattern.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0331:11
type Money = { cents: i64 }

impl Eq for Money {
  fn eq(self, other: Money) -> bool { self.cents == other.cents }
}

const FREE: Money = Money { cents: 0 }

fn label(price: Money) -> str {
  match price {
    FREE => "free"
    _ => "paid"
  }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type Money = { cents: i64 }

impl Eq for Money {
  fn eq(self, other: Money) -> bool { self.cents == other.cents }
}

const FREE: Money = Money { cents: 0 }

fn label(price: Money) -> str {
  if price == FREE { "free" } else { "paid" }
}
```
